title: D-033 T-B: supervisor acceptance engine + independent-verifier seam (switch-gated, DEFAULT OFF)
objective: Implement the D-033 design's T-B slice (docs/SUPERVISOR_MANAGEMENT_LAYER_DESIGN.md): independent verifier-session dispatch; verification-row transcription (worst-of dedup, 64k ceiling) into the directive verification file; controller accept() invocation preserving every precondition; producer!=verifier and self-check-never-satisfies mutation tests; content-identity re-stamp on HEAD drift (design item I3). Also close the two T-A advisories routed here: G5 L1 (run the G2 report body through redact_structure before write_g2_report persists it) and G3 D-2 (wire admit_verdict_file/verify_verdict_report read-back verification into the live wave path, or document them as deliberate defense-in-depth surface). Behind the same owner-gated DEFAULT-OFF switch discipline as T-A; no behavior change while off; cites D-033-R002 and D-033-R006 as qualifying evidence (freeze-rule section 3; D-033 recognition amendment landed via M0-T152). Depends on T-A (M0-T152).
business_reason: D-033-R002/R006: supervisor-run acceptance is the second stage of the owner's management layer; eliminates orchestrator-session acceptance burden once R595-activated.
outputs: tools/agent_supervisor/accept_engine.py (independent verifier-session dispatch; row transcription worst-of dedup under the 64k ceiling; accept() invocation preserving every precondition; identity re-stamp on HEAD drift)
tools/agent_supervisor/gate_wave.py (T-A advisory closures: G5 L1 redact-before-persist in write_g2_report; G3 D-2 live read-back verification or recorded rationale)
forbidden_paths: tools/agent_supervisor/loop.py (at its modularity ceiling; new stage must be a new module)
.claude/** except nothing (freeze-rule amendment already landed via M0-T152), .github/**, other tasks' paths
project-control/directives/** (append-only registry; DCV rows are transcribed by the orchestrator)
documented_test_commands: python -m ruff check tools/agent_supervisor/accept_engine.py tools/agent_supervisor/gate_wave.py tools/agent_supervisor/cli.py tools/test_agent_supervisor_accept_engine.py tools/test_agent_supervisor_gate_wave.py
notes: CHECKPOINT ENVELOPE CONTRACT (DL-2, proven on M0-T152 runs 08/09): in the final checkpoint JSON, starting_sha and current_sha MUST each be either the FULL 40-hex sha (git rev-parse HEAD in the worktree) or the empty string "" (controller enrichment fills empty envelope fields; any abbreviated sha is refused fail-closed). Same rule for branch/worktree: exact or empty.
